dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ever seen a face that looks a lot like mine?

dialogues.speaker: Fugui
dialogues.text: Ah, you've got the right man. I often do face-readings around these parts, and I've read a good many people, too. Let me have a look at your face...

dialogues.speaker: Fugui
dialogues.text: Hmm, let's see... Smooth forehead, square jaw, symmetrical features, beautiful eyes, healthy complexion, could you be...

dialogues.speaker: Fugui
dialogues.text: No, no... How could another person as striking and radiant as you exist?
